Question: Is it necessary for a girl to have a wali(guardian) for proposal of nikah? Are two witnesses(adult male and muslim)not enough? What if a girl marries without a wali and have spent few years with the man? Answer ID: 23073 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1012/1012/M=1431) What do you mean by proposal of nikah? If both the boy and girl are mature and present in the meeting of nikah, and they make ijab-o-qubool (proper exchange of words) of nikah in the presence of two witnesses, the nikah shall be valid and effective. But, if the girl is not present in the meeting of nikah, her wakil or wali should be present in the meeting. When the girl becomes mature though no her guardians (father and grandfather) cannot impose their choice, but it is inappropriate and against the modesty for a girl to marry herself without the permission of her guardians. However she can live with that boy after a valid nikah takes place. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
